Scene:
可是夹竹桃的毒很重，让他肚子很痛。他在地上躺着，觉得他快会死了。可是正好有别人找到他了，给了他一个像伞的植物，叫灵芝。他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好，不再生病了。他测量起来了，像星星的植物是毒，像伞的植物是药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 可是夹竹桃的毒很重：很强
- 觉得他快会死了：快要死了
- 可是正好有别人找到他了：有人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好：吃了，了completed
- 他测量起来了：写下来了

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别人：有人，别人 distinguishes other people from a previously mentioned person or group; here the rescuer is being introduced for the first time, so an indefinite person is needed. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别人：有人，别人 distinguishes other people from a previously mentioned person or group; no such comparison is present here. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 有别人：有人，别人 distinguishes other people from a person or group already under discussion; here, no such contrast has been established. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs identify the misuse of 别人 when introducing an indefinite rescuer and correctly replace it with 有人.
